websiteNote: From 3 pages of their campaign website.

Public safety.summary: Says they have committed to never cutting funding for Arkansas law enforcement agencies.
Public safety.quote: I have made an ironclad commitment NEVER to defund Arkansas law enforcement agencies

Jobs and the economy.summary: Says they will keep giving relief to help Arkansas small businesses grow.
Jobs and the economy.quote: As we emerge from this pandemic, I promise to continue to provide relief to stabilize, foster, and grow Arkansas’s small businesses.

Elections and government.summary: Says every Arkansas elected official should be easy to reach and held accountable.
Elections and government.quote: Every single one of Arkansas’s elected officials needs to be accessible and held to account.

Health care.summary: Says they won a U.S. Supreme Court case on pharmacy benefit managers that they say will lower drug costs.
Health care.quote: Won an 8-0 decision in the Supreme Court of the United States, against pharmacy benefit managers and for independent pharmacies. This will ultimately lower prescription drug costs for all Arkansans.

Immigration.summary: Says they pushed federal officials to arrest and remove immigrants here unlawfully who were convicted of sex crimes.
Immigration.quote: Pushed the Biden Administration to arrest and remove unlawful immigrants convicted of sex crimes.

Energy and the environment.summary: Says they challenged a federal power plant rule that they say would have raised Arkansans' electric rates.
Energy and the environment.quote: Challenged the Obama Administration’s “Clean Power Plan” that would have raised rates on Arkansans and prevented our own state leaders from ensuring our air is clean.

Farming and rural life.summary: Says they joined a lawsuit to stop a federal water rule that they say would have hurt Arkansas farmers and ranchers.
Farming and rural life.quote: Joined a lawsuit to stop the EPA’s Water of the United States Rule. These burdensome, one-size-fits-all regulations would have decimated farmers and ranchers in Arkansas.

Taxes and spending.summary: Says they sued the federal government to protect the state's power to lower taxes.
Taxes and spending.quote: Sued President Biden to protect our state's authority to lower taxes for Arkansans.
